Inspect one resumable research job without waiting

Part of [`seek research`](seek-research.md).

## Usage

```text
seek research status [options] <provider> <job-id>
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | Yes | google \| parallel \| perplexity |  |
| `job-id` | Yes | Opaque provider job id |  |

## Options

| Option | Description | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--json` | Emit the normalized lifecycle envelope and provider payload |  |
| `-h, --help` | display help for command |  |

## Exit statuses

`seek research status` exits with one of the [exit statuses of `seek`](seek.md#exit-statuses).

## Help

The output of `seek research status --help`:

```text
Usage: seek research status [options] <provider> <job-id>

Inspect one resumable research job without waiting

Arguments:
  provider    google | parallel | perplexity
  job-id      Opaque provider job id

Options:
  --json      Emit the normalized lifecycle envelope and provider payload
  -h, --help  display help for command
```
